ValidationRule.description: ESG Team User can only select 'To be onboarded' status. Once the Supplier's status value is updated to 'Supplier Onboarded' by the Admin, the ESG user should not be able to change the Status field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED( NZC_Status__c ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(NZC_Status__c), 'Supplier Onboarded'), ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c, 'ESG Team') ), AND( ISCHANGED( NZC_Status__c ), ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c, 'ESG Team'), OR( ISBLANK( TEXT(NZC_Status__c) ), ISPICKVAL( NZC_Status__c, 'New'), ISPICKVAL( NZC_Status__c, 'Supplier Onboarded') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only select 'To be onboarded' when it's not in 'Supplier onboarded' status
